title: View a specific number of lines from the start of a file
summary: Use the `head` command with the `-n` flag to specify exactly how many lines to display from the beginning of a file.

steps.explain: Use the `-n` (or `--lines`) flag followed by the number of lines you want to see, then the file path.

placeholders.name: NUMBER
placeholders.description: The number of lines to display.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the text file.

alternatives.explain: You can also use the long form `--lines` instead of `-n`.
